topic: Why America and Israel lost despite having a larger military budget than Iran

lines.text: Despite outspending Iran, the United States and Israel face a costly stalemate in the ongoing conflict.
lines.search_term: US and Israeli troops in desert battlefield with Iranian forces

lines.text: A two-week ceasefire in early April showed that diplomatic pauses can halt even the most powerful armies.
lines.search_term: Negotiators signing ceasefire agreement in war room with American and Israeli flags

lines.text: Experts say Iran's resilient defense tactics have turned a high-budget assault into a drawn-out quagmire.
lines.search_term: Iranian missile batteries and soldiers defending mountainous terrain

lines.text: Training accidents claim more American lives each year than actual combat with Iran.
lines.search_term: US soldiers in training accident on military base, wrecked vehicle

lines.text: The $1.5 trillion defense budget request reflects a shift toward endless war spending rather than strategic wins.
lines.search_term: Congressional hearing with officials presenting the defense budget proposal

lines.text: Targeting Iran's leadership has inflicted damage, yet the core military structure remains largely intact.
lines.search_term: Aerial view of Iranian command center ruins after strike

lines.text: Iran's smaller but highly motivated forces exploit terrain advantages that large budgets cannot overcome.
lines.search_term: Iranian infantry navigating rugged canyon at sunrise

lines.text: Logistical overreach stretches American supply lines, causing delays and resource shortages.
lines.search_term: Convoy of US military trucks stuck in desert dust storm

lines.text: Israel's reliance on air superiority faces sophisticated Iranian air defenses that blunt its advantage.
lines.search_term: Israeli fighter jets evading Iranian surface-to-air missile launchers

lines.text: Ultimately, sheer spending cannot guarantee victory when strategy, terrain, and morale favor the underdog.
lines.search_term: Military budget chart displayed beside Iranian infantry on a battlefield
